Bundled runtime dependency closure for offline/mobile qualification
==================================================================
alchemy_foreign_object_v0.2: AlchemyForeignObject.cls; shared authoritative foreign-object base.
alchemy_objects_v0.8: AlchemyObject.cls, AlchemySecurity.cls, AlchemyLockedMethod.cls, AlchemyEvidence.cls.
oorexx_runtime_support: crypto.cls and json.cls.
Deployment copies are pinned for clean-machine/Termux qualification. .NET Alchemy does not claim ownership of the shared dependencies.
